option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and diagnostic findings, including the presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results, are consistent with Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma (PCNSL).
Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma is a distinct clinical entity that does not match the provided diagnostic findings.
Secondary CNS involvement by systemic diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is not supported by the diagnostic findings, which suggest a primary CNS lymphoma.
Lymphomatosis cerebri variant of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is a subtype of PCNSL, but the provided diagnostic findings do not specifically support this subtype.
